content.name: Sarah Mitchell
content.title: Senior Sales Associate
content.summary: Senior sales associate with 15 years across surfwear, furniture, optical and appliance retail in Perth. Combines high personal sales ($1.1m last financial year) with floor leadership: rosters, onboarding and stepping in as acting manager when needed.

experience.title: Senior Sales Associate
bullets: Achieved $1.1m in personal sales in FY2025, mainly premium kitchen packages and laundry, at an average margin above store target.
Act as store manager during leave periods for up to four weeks at a time, running a team of nine and the weekly roster.
Built relationships with 25 local builders and kitchen designers, who now send roughly a fifth of the store's renovation customers.
Explain consumer guarantee rights clearly at the counter, which helped drop escalated complaints by about a third.

experience.title: Senior Sales Consultant
bullets: Dispensed frames and lenses alongside two optometrists, reaching 118% of my annual sales target in 2021.
Explained private health fund rebates and lens options in plain language, raising premium lens uptake from 29% to 41%.
Took over recall lists and contacted 300 patients a month whose prescriptions were due.

experience.title: Sales Consultant
bullets: Sold lounge, dining and bedroom furniture with a personal average of $62,000 a month.
Arranged custom fabric orders with two local manufacturers and tracked lead times for each customer.
Mentored three new consultants, sharing call-back scripts that lifted their follow-up sales.

experience.title: Retail Sales Assistant
bullets: Served customers across wetsuits, boards and apparel during busy summer trade.
Processed hire bookings for boards and stand-up paddleboards, handling up to 40 hires on peak days.
Restocked and rearranged displays weekly with the visual merchandiser.

education.school: John Curtin College of the Arts

courses.name: Certificate III in Retail
courses.provider: Retail traineeship, completed on the job

achievements.title: Top seller FY2024 and FY2025
achievements.detail: Highest personal sales across the store two financial years running.

achievements.title: Acting manager
achievements.detail: Covered management leave periods totalling 11 weeks with no missed stocktake or payroll deadline.
